name: ledger
title: Ledger
summary: Warm paper, hairline rules instead of cards, serif headings, 30px rows
description: A document-like alternative to Signal: warm paper ground, 1px rules instead of card elevation, Source Serif headings over Source Sans body, 2px corners and 30px rows. Same Atlas wiring as every mxcli theme, so it swaps in without touching a page. Ships light and dark palettes.

files.purpose: Layer 1 — the Ledger palette (light): brand, surfaces, ink, density
the Atlas wiring — shared by every mxcli theme, identical in each
the other palette, the variant blocks, @font-face, and this theme's own skin rules
the recipe layer — num / pill / stat / focus / density, shared by every theme
the widget-module layer — rules for colours Sass bakes before any token exists
variant switch + imports — this file compiles last, so the partials win
vendored Source Sans 3 + Source Serif 4 (SIL OFL 1.1, OFL-ledger.txt) — no CDN at runtime
